cohort: The study included 1760 preterm infants with a gestational age between 24(+0/7) and 31(+6/7) weeks/days, born by uncomplicated delivery, and who received antenatal corticosteroids.
finding: Cesarean section was associated with a significantly lower risk of intraventricular hemorrhage (grades I-IV) compared to vaginal delivery in preterm infants.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with a significantly lower risk of intraventricular hemorrhage compared to vaginal delivery in preterm infants.
followup_time: within the first week of life
